description: This file implements a client-side React component for an interactive skill validation chat interface. It manages state, user interactions, guided conversation flow, and local persona data storage. The component facilitates a guided flow for users to validate skills through structured prompts, options, and user inputs within a chat-like UI.

methods.name: safeTrim
methods.description: Sanitizes an input by converting it to string and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: toTopUnique
methods.description: Filters an array of strings to its top unique values up to a limit, ignoring case and whitespace.

methods.name: derivePersonaContext
methods.description: Extracts relevant persona data such as title, summary, headline, skills, and strengths from a raw JSON object.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string with a prefix and timestamp.
